title: Frontend Engineer Senior Path
summary: A step‑by‑step roadmap that builds deep technical foundations, sharpens core engineering skills, creates showcase projects, and prepares you for senior‑level roles. Follow each phase to gain confidence, a strong portfolio, and interview readiness.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Solidify web basics and development workflow.

milestones.title: HTML & CSS Mastery
milestones.outcome: Can build pixel‑perfect, responsive layouts from mockups.

tasks.title: Read HTML5 spec overview
tasks.description: Skim the HTML5 introduction on MDN to understand document structure and semantics.

tasks.title: Complete CSS Flexbox tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the freeCodeCamp Flexbox module and build a simple navigation bar.

tasks.title: Build a responsive landing page
tasks.description: Create a static page using semantic HTML and CSS Grid that adapts to three breakpoints.

tasks.title: Reflect on accessibility tags used
tasks.description: Write a short note on why each semantic element was chosen and its impact on accessibility.

tasks.title: Connect with a design peer for review
tasks.description: Share the landing page on a dev community forum and ask for feedback on markup clarity.

milestones.title: Version Control & Tooling
milestones.outcome: Can manage codebases confidently with Git and modern dev tools.

tasks.title: Read Git branching guide on Atlassian
tasks.description: Understand main, develop, feature, and release branches and their purposes.

tasks.title: Create a Git repo and commit landing page
tasks.description: Initialize a repository, make meaningful commits, and push to GitHub.

tasks.title: Set up VS Code with recommended extensions
tasks.description: Install ESLint, Prettier, and Live Server extensions and configure settings.json.

tasks.title: Reflect on commit message conventions
tasks.description: Write three example commit messages following Conventional Commits.

tasks.title: Connect with a senior engineer for code review
tasks.description: Request a quick review of your repo to learn best practices.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Deepen JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and performance expertise.

milestones.title: Advanced JavaScript & TypeScript
milestones.outcome: Can write type‑safe, modular code and debug complex issues.

tasks.title: Read ES2023 features on MDN
tasks.description: Identify new syntax and practice each with a small snippet.

tasks.title: Complete TypeScript basics on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Follow the TypeScript module and type a simple utility library.

tasks.title: Refactor landing page to TSX
tasks.description: Convert the HTML/CSS page into a React component using TypeScript types.

tasks.title: Debug a runtime error with Chrome DevTools
tasks.description: Introduce a deliberate bug, locate it using the Sources panel, and fix it.

tasks.title: Reflect on type‑safety benefits
tasks.description: Write a brief note on how TypeScript prevented a bug in your refactor.

milestones.title: React & State Management
milestones.outcome: Can build scalable UI with hooks, context, and performance patterns.

tasks.title: Read official React docs on hooks
tasks.description: Study useState, useEffect, and custom hook patterns on reactjs.org.

tasks.title: Build a reusable modal component
tasks.description: Create a modal with open/close state, portal rendering, and accessibility attributes.

tasks.title: Implement context for theme switching
tasks.description: Add a ThemeContext provider and toggle dark/light mode across the app.

tasks.title: Profile component render performance
tasks.description: Use React Profiler to identify unnecessary renders and memoize where needed.

tasks.title: Connect with a React community mentor
tasks.description: Join a Discord channel and ask for feedback on your component design.

milestones.title: Accessibility & Performance
milestones.outcome: Can audit and improve sites for users and speed.

tasks.title: Read WCAG 2.1 intro on W3C
tasks.description: Understand the four principles and key success criteria.

tasks.title: Run Lighthouse audit on landing page
tasks.description: Generate a report, note accessibility and performance scores, and list three improvements.

tasks.title: Add ARIA roles to modal component
tasks.description: Ensure the modal is announced correctly and focus is trapped while open.

tasks.title: Optimize images with ImageOptim
tasks.description: Compress assets, replace them, and verify load time reduction.

tasks.title: Reflect on trade‑offs made
tasks.description: Write a short paragraph about balancing accessibility with design constraints.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that demonstrate senior‑level competence.

milestones.title: Responsive Portfolio Site
milestones.outcome: Can showcase your skills with a polished, mobile‑first site.

tasks.title: Plan site structure on paper
tasks.description: Sketch pages, navigation, and component hierarchy before coding.

tasks.title: Build site with React & TS
tasks.description: Implement home, projects, and contact pages using reusable components.

tasks.title: Add dark mode via context
tasks.description: Provide a toggle that persists the theme in localStorage.

tasks.title: Conduct accessibility audit
tasks.description: Run axe-core in the browser and fix any violations.

tasks.title: Deploy to Netlify and share link
tasks.description: Push the repo, configure Netlify, and post the live URL for feedback.

milestones.title: API Dashboard
milestones.outcome: Can integrate external data, handle async flows, and visualize results.

tasks.title: Select a public API on RapidAPI
tasks.description: Choose an API with JSON responses suitable for a dashboard view.

tasks.title: Create data fetching hook
tasks.description: Write a custom hook that uses fetch, error handling, and caching.

tasks.title: Render charts with Chart.js
tasks.description: Display fetched data in line and bar charts, ensuring responsiveness.

tasks.title: Implement loading & error UI states
tasks.description: Show skeleton loaders and friendly error messages during fetch cycles.

tasks.title: Gather peer feedback on UX
tasks.description: Invite a colleague to test the dashboard and note improvement suggestions.

milestones.title: Component Library
milestones.outcome: Can produce reusable, documented UI components for teams.

tasks.title: Define component API design guidelines
tasks.description: Write a short spec for props, defaults, and accessibility for each component.

tasks.title: Build a button component library
tasks.description: Create primary, secondary, and disabled button variants with TypeScript typings.

tasks.title: Write Storybook docs for components
tasks.description: Set up Storybook, add stories, and include usage notes.

tasks.title: Run visual regression tests
tasks.description: Configure Chromatic (free tier) to catch unintended UI changes.

tasks.title: Publish package to npm (public demo)
tasks.description: Package the library, add a README, and publish a demo version on npm.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Advance leadership, performance mastery, and senior interview preparation.

milestones.title: Web Performance Mastery
milestones.outcome: Can audit, optimize, and explain performance improvements to stakeholders.

tasks.title: Read Web Vitals guide on web.dev
tasks.description: Understand LCP, FID, CLS and how to measure them.

tasks.title: Implement code-splitting with React.lazy
tasks.description: Refactor the dashboard to load heavy charts lazily.

tasks.title: Add Service Worker for offline caching
tasks.description: Configure Workbox to cache static assets and API responses.

tasks.title: Measure improvements with Lighthouse
tasks.description: Run before/after audits and document metric changes.

tasks.title: Explain optimizations in a mock interview
tasks.description: Record a 5‑minute explanation of your performance work for a peer audience.

milestones.title: Leadership & Collaboration
milestones.outcome: Can mentor junior developers and lead technical discussions.

tasks.title: Read article on TypeScript for large teams
tasks.description: Study best practices for type safety and API contracts on the TypeScript blog.

tasks.title: Host a code review session
tasks.description: Invite two peers to review a PR from your component library and facilitate feedback.

tasks.title: Write a technical blog post
tasks.description: Explain a complex React pattern you used, publishing on dev.to.

tasks.title: Create a mentorship plan
tasks.description: Outline goals, resources, and meeting cadence for a junior mentee.

tasks.title: Connect with a senior engineering manager
tasks.description: Schedule a 30‑minute chat to discuss leadership expectations.

milestones.title: Senior Interview Prep
milestones.outcome: Can confidently tackle system design, coding, and behavioral interviews.

tasks.title: Study React system design case on educative.io
tasks.description: Read the case study and note scaling considerations.

tasks.title: Solve 5 algorithm problems on LeetCode (medium)
tasks.description: Focus on array and string challenges using JavaScript.

tasks.title: Mock whiteboard design session
tasks.description: Sketch a component architecture for a real‑time chat app with a peer.

tasks.title: Prepare STAR stories for leadership questions
tasks.description: Write three concise stories highlighting impact and teamwork.

tasks.title: Attend a virtual frontend interview meetup
tasks.description: Join a free meetup to practice live coding with strangers.
